verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents private status pages for internal teams or enterprise customers, protected by SSO, password, and IP restrictions. Its getting-started docs specifically describe using password protection to limit access to chosen people. Missing for 10: in-depth docs for SSO- and IP-based access setup (marketing-level only), explicit evidence of per-customer audience scoping beyond the claim of "full control over who sees what", and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, I can run private or internal status pages with access control for customer-specific or employee-only audiences

citations.quote: SSO, password, and IP protection. Create a private status page for internal teams or enterprise customers.
Have full control over who sees what.
To create a private status page, use the password protection to only allow chosen people to access it.
